style: a cinematic, photoreal night-time automotive commercial shot, high contrast, deep near-black shadows with orange rim light, no text, no logos
setting: a dark wet runway at night with small orange edge lights

subjects.desc: a sleek unbranded electric hypercar, dark grey with orange rim light, no badges or text

shots.camera: The camera slowly pushes in toward the car.
shots.action: The car hovers steadily about one metre above the runway on four bright white jets of compressed air; mist billows and swirls outward across the wet ground; reflections ripple.

soundscape: A steady loud hiss of compressed air jets and swirling wind over a wet runway.
